shortDescription: Targa Resources NYSE:TRGP rises 3.3% in Friday's trading as TD Cowen upgraded the oil and gas infrastructure company to Buy from Hold with a $350 price target, raised from $275, citing expected Permian Basin wet gas growth and peer-leading EBITDA growth.TD Cowen's Jason Gabelman said Targa NYSE:TRG…

children: rises 3.3% in Friday's trading as TD Cowen upgraded the oil and gas infrastructure company to Buy from Hold with a $350 price target, raised from $275, citing expected Permian Basin wet gas growth and peer-leading EBITDA growth.
TD Cowen's Jason Gabelman said Targa

has demonstrated an ability to grow its Permian gas processing volumes at a better pace than underlying robust Permian gas growth, which should continue with support by producer Permian activity and expanding gas-to-oil ratios.

outperformance is supported by its strong relationship with growing producer customers, Gabelman said, forecasting 17 new processing plants through 2030 and two plants per year beyond 2030, underpinned by maintaining market share plus its relationship with Permian-growth leader Exxon.
